summary.service_description: an office visit at Sound Orthopedics on November 12, 2025
summary.plain_language_summary: Your claim for an office visit was partly paid by your plan. The total billed was $285.00, but the plan only allowed $165.00 for this service.
summary.what_happened: The plan paid $132.00 of the allowed amount, and you are responsible for the remaining $33.00.
summary.why_adjusted: The charge was reduced to the allowed amount because the provider billed more than what the plan allows for this service. This is known as 'Charge reduced to allowed amount'. Since this was an in-network visit, you are only responsible for the allowed amount, not the full billed charge.
next_steps: You can review your Explanation of Benefits (EOB) for more details.
If you receive a bill from the provider for more than $33.00, contact Pacific HMO Member Services at 1-800-555-0142 for assistance.
summary.appeal_rights_summary: If you disagree with this decision, you have the right to appeal. You must file your appeal within 60 days from EOB date. To start an appeal or ask questions, call Pacific HMO Member Services at 1-800-555-0142.

summary.service_description: MRI of the lumbar spine at Northwest MRI Center on November 5, 2025
summary.plain_language_summary: Your claim for an MRI of the lumbar spine was not paid by your plan because it did not have the required prior authorization. This means that the necessary approval was not obtained before the service was provided.
summary.what_happened: The claim was denied because there was no prior authorization on file for the MRI service.
summary.why_adjusted: The claim was denied because prior authorization required but not on file. This means that the service needed approval before it was done, and that approval was not obtained. Without this authorization, the claim cannot be paid.
summary.amounts_note: The allowed amount, the amount your plan paid and the amount you owe are not available on this claim yet. Call Pacific HMO Member Services at 1-800-555-0142 for the latest status.
next_steps: Ask your provider to submit a request for retroactive authorization if eligible.
If retroactive authorization is not possible, consider appealing the decision with clinical documentation.
If you have questions, call Pacific HMO Member Services at 1-800-555-0142 and have your claim number ready.
summary.appeal_rights_summary: If you disagree with this decision, you have the right to appeal. You must file your appeal within 60 days from EOB date. To start an appeal or ask questions, call Pacific HMO Member Services at 1-800-555-0142.
